meaning.en: Third-person singular simple present indicative form of mildew.
meaning.vi: Ngôi thứ ba số ít, hiện tại đơn giản dạng biểu thị của nấm mốc.

sentences.en: Owing to their appearance they go by the popular name of mildews.
sentences.vi: Do vẻ ngoài của chúng, chúng được gọi với cái tên phổ biến là nấm mốc.

sentences.en: Fungal foliar diseases and their control, including leaf blights, downy mildews, leaf blights, downy mildews, leaf curls, mildews, leaf spots and rusts.

sentences.en: The existence of blights and mildews of cereals had been observed and recorded in very ancient times, as witness the Bible, where half a dozen references to such scourges occur in the Old Testament alone.
